_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of the Meraki rows still in the meraki category, 14 Sep 2026 (the MS switches moved to switches on 14 Sep). One line per Meraki product family. Most rows are bare family names ('Cisco MV63'). The access-point and switch roles are NOT set here: deployRole reads the wireless series table for meraki access points and the switches table for meraki switches, so the roles stay one table per noun.
